Package threepl.parser

Class BENode

java.lang.Object
threepl.parser.BENode
All Implemented Interfaces:
Constant
public class BENode extends Object implements Constant
This class implements a boolean expression node. This node is used to construct expression trees for boolean expressions used in LUTs.
